name: mpljs
description: Pure-JavaScript, zero-dependency reproduction of matplotlib's output (SVG and PNG), verified against matplotlib itself
author: Ivar Vong <ivar@ivarvong.com>

scripts.test: npm run check && node test/compare.mjs && node test/fonts.test.mjs && node test/png.test.mjs && node test/glyphcache.test.mjs && node test/view.test.mjs && node test/fuzz-ticker.mjs && node test/fuzz-dates.mjs && node test/trace.test.mjs
scripts.fuzz: python3 fixtures/fuzz_ticker.py && python3 fixtures/fuzz_dates.py && node test/fuzz-ticker.mjs && node test/fuzz-dates.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run strict && npm run lint
